common_name: Giant-Sperm Repleta Fly (58 mm Coiled Testicular Sperm Tail & Spotted Thorax)

phenomenon_scale.anatomical_structure: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength in Drosophila hydei (2.3 µm, detail scale)

predecessor.note: picture-wing pigment band at the primordium tier; coarser wavenumber

successor.note: Sophophora montium female tergite pigment scale; not the repleta detail wavenumber

equations.kinetics: du/dt = γ (a - u + u^2 v) + D_u ∇²u; dv/dt = γ (b - u^2 v) + D_v ∇²v
equations.dispersion: σ(k) = ½ (tr_k + sqrt(tr_k^2 - 4 det_k)); tr_k = f_u + g_v - (D_u+D_v) k^2; det_k = D_u D_v k^4 - (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) k^2 + (f_u g_v - f_v g_u)
equations.critical_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v); λ_c = 2π / k_c
equations.gamma_scaling: λ_c(γ) = λ_c(1) / sqrt(γ) when γ multiplies both reaction terms and diffusion is held fixed
equations.boundary_condition: periodic on a square of side 4 λ_c

reported_in_source: Turing 1952 critical-wavenumber instability of a homogeneous two-morphogen equilibrium
Pitnick, Spicer & Markow 1995 Nature and PNAS on giant Drosophila sperm and delayed male maturity
Gompel et al. 2005 cis-regulatory origin of a Drosophila wing pigment spot
reconstructed_in_script: Schnakenberg parameters a=0.10, b=0.90, Du=1, Dv=20, gamma=1 with the length unit fixed so λ_c = 2.344 µm
Chronoseries ratios versus D. heteroneura 175.4 µm, D. hydei primordium 117.2 µm, and D. kikkawai 93.41 µm
does_not_claim: A measured 2.3 µm Turing wavelength on D. hydei cuticle
That the whole-animal photograph resolves that wavelength
That 58 mm was re-measured as this species' sperm length in this loop
That cis-regulatory pigment patterning is ruled out
